results.title: Automation Data Systems Engineer | Aveva PI & OT Platforms
results.description:
Eli Lilly Nederland B.V. in Katwijk, Netherlands, seeks an Automation Data Systems Engineer to support Aveva PI and related data systems. The role ensures reliability, compliance, and performance from start-up through steady-state operations, joining the global automation team before transitioning to site-based delivery.

The position is 100% on-site, with 10–20% travel during design and delivery. 12-month contract with view to permanent based on fit and mutual agreement.

results.title: Automation Engineer – Data Historian and OT Platforms
results.description:
At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.

About the Katwijk Site This position starts with a 12-month contract, with the intention of offering a permanent contract based on mutual fit. (Dienstverband: tijdelijk met uitzicht op vast) Eli Lilly is investing €2.6 billion in a new state-of-the-art manufacturing facility in Katwijk, Netherlands. This facility will produce oral medicines for cardiometabolic health, neuroscience, oncology, and immunology, incorporating next-generation manufacturing technologies including dock-to-dock automation, paperless manufacturing, and process analytical technology while achieving carbon neutrality and zero waste to landfills.

Position Overview The Automation Data Systems Engineer supports the Aveva PI based Data Historian and other data systems at the Katwijk site. This role ensures the reliability, compliance, and continuous performance of the automation data systems from site startup through steady-state operations. During the design and delivery of the project this role will be integrated into the global automation team and then transition fully to a site-based process team position.

### Key Responsibilities

- Partner with Corporate Automation, Automation Integrators, and Global Facilities delivery to design, install, and qualify the site Aveva PI based Data Historian and other data systems.
- System Administration ownership of these data platforms post-delivery including user access controls, life cycle management, process improvements, data management, and system maintenance.
- Manage and own the system security including data integrity.
- Perform audits and periodic assessments of the data systems to ensure compliance with Global Quality and Engineering Standards.
- Lead the management and growth of the data platforms and support of manufacturing process teams as new systems are added to the facility.
- Partner with Corporate Automation, Information Technology, and Information Security for global initiatives and life cycle management.
- Develop site procedures that will govern the Data Historian and other data systems.

### Qualifications & Requirements

- Education Bachelor’s degree in engineering or related science field
- Professional fluency in English
- Experience/Technical Knowledge 5+ years in automation 5+ years in pharmaceutical or other regulated industries Knowledge of GMPs, regulatory requirements, computer system validation.
- 3+ years of experience in Aveva PI Data Historian administration including hardware design, software integration, and system procedures.
- Experience in Microsoft operating systems, virtual environments, and networking.
- Experience in ISA S95 Manufacturing Enterprise IT/Automation integration principles.
- Experience in managing IT/OT platforms.

### Additional Skills/Preferences

- Experience in IT Infrastructure and Networking
- Experience in Citrix Application publishing
- Experience in virtual environments (VMware)
- Experience in manufacturing connectivity software (i.e., OPC Server such as Kepware, Matrikon)
- Experience in relational enterprise databases (i.e., SQL Server).

### On-site Requirement

This is 100% full-time on-site role

### Travel requirements

We typically expect travel to be 10-20% during the design and delivery phase for engineering meetings, training, and job shadowing opportunities.

results.title: Automation QA Engineer
results.description:
**Ciklum** is looking for an **Automation QA Engineer** to join our team full-time in Ukraine.

We are a custom product engineering company that supports both multinational organizations and scaling startups to solve their most complex business challenges. With a global team of over 4,000 highly skilled developers, consultants, analysts and product owners, we engineer technology that redefines industries and shapes the way people live.

**About the role:**

As an Automation QA Engineer, become a part of the team who works on one of the critical domains by executing critical Partner Data consolidation.

As a recently formed team, they have many opportunities and ideas for sharing value back to the customers within their continuously expanding platform. They're looking for talented and trusted engineers to help them impress their customers.

**Responsibilities:**

- Design and execute automated tests, performance benchmarks, and security validations for the consolidated data platforms
- Ensure data migrations and unified APIs meet strict latency, throughput, and security requirements
- Be a collaborative member of a modern software team by owning, supporting and contributing to processes, standards, and designs alongside engineering teams in the UK, Germany, Netherlands, Canada and beyond
- Be product-oriented. Develop software that other people want to use, define product features, participate in workshops with other product development teams and communicate the technical work of your team to other product development teams
- Own workstreams and track the progress you are making towards the wider goals of your team, and transparently communicate that progress to your team and Technology Manager
- Ensure you and others continuously improve by proposing and implementing new processes, designs and engineering practices that make your team more effective
- Take responsibility for supporting your changes all the way through to proving that they work well – and continue to work well – in production

**Requirements:**

- 3+ years of professional experience as Automation QA
- Experience with Automated Testing Frameworks, Performance Profiling Tools, and Security Testing practices
- Able to work independently and collaborate to solve complex problems
- Experience in an Agile environment (Scrum, Kanban)
- Critical thinking and good communication skills

**Personal skills:**

- Perform a broad range of complex technical or professional activities, in a variety of contexts
- Investigate, define and resolve complex issues
- Able to work in distributed cross-functional teams effectively
- Influence customers and team members on the project level
- Plan, schedule and monitor your own work competently
- Have learning agility (readiness for challenge and being open to change)
- Confident Intermediate English (or higher) is a must

**What’s in it for you?**

- Strong community: Work alongside top professionals in a friendly, open-door environment
- Growth focus: Take on large-scale projects with a global impact and expand your expertise
- Tailored learning: Boost your skills with internal events (meetups, conferences, workshops), Udemy access, language courses, and company-paid certifications
- Endless opportunities: Explore diverse domains through internal mobility, finding the best fit to gain hands-on experience with cutting-edge technologies
- Flexibility: Enjoy radical flexibility – work remotely or from an office, your choice
- Care: We’ve got you covered with company-paid medical insurance, mental health support, and financial & legal consultations

**About us:**

At Ciklum, we are always exploring innovations, empowering each other to achieve more, and engineering solutions that matter. With us, you’ll work with cutting-edge technologies, contribute to impactful projects, and be part of a One Team culture that values collaboration and progress.

As one of Ukraine’s largest IT companies and a top employer recognized by Forbes, we’ve spent over 20 years delivering meaningful tech solutions. We proudly support diverse talent and military veterans, recognizing their unique skills and perspectives they bring to shaping the future.

**Explore, empower, engineer with Ciklum!**

Interested already? We would love to get to know you! Submit your application. We can’t wait to see you at Ciklum.

results.title: Automation QA Engineer – (FinTech / Payments)
results.description:
We are looking for an experienced QA Engineer to join our team and help ensure the reliability, security, and quality of a PCI DSS Level 1 compliant payment platform processing live SEPA, SWIFT, and Visa card transactions.

You will work across web and mobile applications, microservices, APIs, and payment infrastructure, validating complete transaction lifecycles and complex integrations. The role combines functional and end-to-end testing, API and integration testing, test automation, resilience testing, security validation, and payment flow verification.

You’ll work closely with developers, DevOps, and security teams to ensure the platform remains stable, secure, and reliable across UAT and production release cycles.

Key Responsibilities

Execute and maintain 63 structured end-to-end test scenarios covering SEPA, SWIFT, and Visa payment flows.  
Test SEPA credit transfers via Centrolink, SWIFT MT / ISO 20022 flows via Microgateway, and Visa card payments including 3DS2 authentication.  
Perform comprehensive testing of web and mobile applications across functional, integration, regression, exploratory, and end-to-end scenarios.  
Perform API, contract, schema, and microservice integration testing using Postman, REST Assured, or similar tools.  
Validate complete payment transaction lifecycles across multiple services and systems.  
Test synchronous and asynchronous workflows, including queues, retries, dead-letter queues (DLQ), and event-driven processing.  
Perform resilience and failure testing, including failover, retries, circuit breakers, idempotency, recovery, and fallback scenarios.  
Validate data integrity and transaction consistency across distributed systems.  
Perform reconciliation and settlement testing to ensure financial transaction accuracy.  
Conduct performance, load, and stress testing to validate platform scalability and stability.  
Validate security controls, authentication, authorization, encryption, and secure session flows.  
Contribute to PCI DSS Level 1 compliance validation and produce structured, audit-ready test evidence and traceability documentation.  
Develop and maintain automated test suites and integrate them into CI/CD pipelines.  
Identify, document, track, retest, and verify defects throughout UAT and release cycles.  
Perform cross-platform compatibility and regression testing across web and mobile applications.  
Collaborate closely with developers, DevOps, and security teams to investigate issues and improve overall platform quality.

Requirements

5+ years of QA experience, including at least 3+ years working with FinTech, banking, payments, or financial platforms.  
Strong hands-on experience with test automation and test development.  
Strong experience in API testing and microservice integration testing using Postman, REST Assured, or similar tools.  
Practical programming experience with Java, JavaScript/TypeScript, or Python for test automation.  
Hands-on experience with automation frameworks such as Playwright, Cypress, or Selenium.  
Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or similar tools.  
Experience testing SEPA, SWIFT, Visa card payment flows, and ISO 20022 messaging.  
Strong understanding of end-to-end payment transaction lifecycles, reconciliation, and settlement processes.  
Experience testing distributed and event-driven systems, including queues, retries, DLQs, and asynchronous workflows.  
Strong understanding of resilience testing concepts, including failover, circuit breakers, retries, and idempotency.  
Experience with PCI DSS controls and audit-oriented QA documentation.  
Understanding of OWASP security concepts, authentication, authorization, and encryption.  
Familiarity with AWS environments, CloudWatch, logging, monitoring, and observability.  
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a high level of attention to detail.  
Good communication skills and the ability to work effectively with engineering, DevOps, security, and product teams.  
Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments.

Nice to Have

Familiarity with Java Spring Boot APIs.  
Experience with OWASP Top 10, MFA, and access control testing.  
Experience testing React-based applications.  
Experience with security testing tools such as Burp Suite, OWASP ZAP, SAST/DAST tools.  
Experience with mobile testing tools such as Appium or BrowserStack.  
Experience testing complex asynchronous payment processing and event-driven architectures.  
Knowledge of secure session and authentication flow validation.  
Experience with cloud-based payment or financial infrastructure.

What We Offer

Opportunity to work on a cutting-edge AI-powered neobanking platform.  
An international team focused on innovation and product excellence.

results.title: Automation System Engineer
results.description:
Numer rekrutacji: 76432

**Firma zbudowana na przełomowych dokonaniach.**  
**Dołącz do nas.**

Corning jest jednym z wiodących światowych innowatorów w dziedzinie szkła, ceramiki i materiałoznawstwa. Od głębin oceanu po najdalsze zakątki kosmosu, nasze technologie przesuwają granice tego, co możliwe.

Jak to robimy? Dzięki naszym ludziom. Przełamują ograniczenia i oczekiwania - nie tylko podczas swojej pracy, ale każdego dnia. Pomagają naszej firmie i światu iść naprzód.

W Corning istnieją nieskończone możliwości wpływania na rzeczywistość. Możesz pomóc w łączeniu tego, co niepołączone, napędzać przyszłość motoryzacji, przekształcać domową rozrywkę i zapewniać dostawę leków ratujących życie. I wiele więcej.

Dokonaj przełomu razem z nami.

Segment komunikacji optycznej niedawno przeprofilował swoją działalność z produkcji światłowodów, kabli, sprzętu i wyposażenia na dostarczanie innowacyjnych kompleksowych rozwiązań optycznych dla branży telekomunikacyjnej. Segment ten podzielony został na dwie podstawowe grupy produktów: sieci operatorów i sieci firm. Grupa produktów w ramach sieci operatorów obejmuje przede wszystkim produkty i rozwiązania dla infrastruktury komunikacyjnej na bazie technologii optycznych pod kątem przesyłania obrazu, danych i głosu. Grupa produktów w ramach sieci firm obejmuje przede wszystkim sieci komunikacyjne na bazie technologii optycznych sprzedawanych przedsiębiorstwom, jednostkom rządowym i osobom prywatnym.

Do naszego zespołu poszukujemy osoby, która będzie łączyć potrzeby produkcji z rozwiązaniami z zakresu automatyzacji. To rola dla kogoś, kto dobrze odnajduje się na styku techniki, organizacji oraz współpracy między zespołami, potrafi spojrzeć szerzej na projekt, uporządkować wymagania i skutecznie przeprowadzić temat od koncepcji aż do wdrożenia.

## Jakie będą Twoje zadania:

- opracowywaniem koncepcji rozwiązań automatyzacyjnych dopasowanych do potrzeb produkcji,
- zbieraniem i doprecyzowywaniem wymagań pomiędzy zespołem automatyki a wewnętrznymi klientami, np. produkcją, planowaniem, utrzymaniem ruchu czy działem operacyjnym,
- definiowaniem zakresu projektów, wymagań technicznych oraz założeń do wdrożenia,
- tworzeniem i prowadzeniem roadmapy projektów dla zespołu automatyki,
- koordynowaniem ustaleń dotyczących nowych stanowisk, setupów oraz przekazań do produkcji,
- wspieraniem procesu wdrażania rozwiązań aż do etapu uruchomienia i przekazania do realizacji,
- pełnieniem roli technicznego lidera w wybranych obszarach projektu,
- dbaniem o spójność techniczną rozwiązań oraz terminową realizację prac.

## Nasze Oczekiwania:

- osoby z wykształceniem technicznym, najlepiej w obszarze automatyki, mechatroniki, mechaniki lub pokrewnym,
- z doświadczeniem w pracy przy projektach automatyzacji, integracji systemów lub wdrożeniach technicznych,
- potrafiącej łączyć wymagania biznesowe i produkcyjne z realiami technicznymi,
- swobodnie komunikującej się z różnymi zespołami, m.in. z produkcją, planowaniem, automatyką, konstrukcją i software’em,
- rozumiejącej zagadnienia z obszaru mechaniki, elektryki, sterowania oraz integracji systemów,
- samodzielnej, dobrze zorganizowanej i nastawionej na rozwiązywanie problemów,
- z dobrą znajomością języka angielskiego.

## Doświadczenie Mile Widziane:

- doświadczenie w prowadzeniu tematów przekrojowych i pracy w środowisku wielodyscyplinarnym,
- umiejętność definiowania wymagań oraz prowadzenia ustaleń technicznych z wewnętrznymi klientami,
- doświadczenie we wdrażaniu nowych setupów, linii lub stanowisk produkcyjnych,
- praktyka w pracy z dokumentacją techniczną i planami wdrożeniowymi.

Praca, która kształtuje życie.

Corning oferuje Ci pełen pakiet.

- Twoje dobre samopoczucie jest naszym priorytetem. Nasz pakiet wynagrodzeń i świadczeń wspiera Twoje zdrowie i dobre samopoczucie, cele finansowe i karierę od pierwszego dnia.
- Firmowe premie i długoterminowe nagrody są dostosowane do kluczowych wyników biznesowych i gwarantują, że zostaniesz nagrodzony, gdy firma osiąga sukcesy. Gdy Corning wygrywa, wszyscy wygrywamy.
- W ramach naszego zaangażowania w Twoje dobro finansowe oferujemy świadczenie emerytalne, które rośnie wraz z Twoją karierą.
- Nasze świadczenia zdrowotne obejmują opiekę medyczną, kartę Multisport, opłacane przez firmę ubezpieczenie na życie, płatny urlop oraz Program Wsparcia Pracowników, który wspiera Ciebie i Twoją rodzinę.
- Otrzymywanie wynagrodzenia za naszą pracę jest ważne, ale poczucie docenienia i uznania motywuje nas znacznie bardziej. Dlatego firma Corning oferuje program uznania, aby świętować sukcesy i nagradzać współpracowników, którzy wnoszą wyjątkowy wkład w działalność firmy.

Auto/Mechanical

Corning zobowiązuje się do zapewnienia równych szans zatrudnienia i rozpatruje wnioski o odpowiednie udogodnienia zgodnie z obowiązującymi przepisami prawa. Osoby z niepełnosprawnościami lub posiadające głębokie przekonania religijne mogą zwrócić się z prośbą o odpowiednie udogodnienia, aby móc uczestniczyć w procesie aplikacyjnym lub rozmowie kwalifikacyjnej, wykonywać podstawowe obowiązki służbowe lub uzyskać dostęp do innych świadczeń związanych z zatrudnieniem. Aby złożyć wniosek o odpowiednie udogodnienia związane z niepełnosprawnością lub religią, prosimy o kontakt pod adresem accommodations@corning.com.

results.title: Automation Engineer - PLC & UX,  Process Automation (all genders)
results.description:
**Hünenberg | Full time**

**Start: By agreement**

**Your position**

As Automation Engineer within the PLC & UX Controls, Process Automation skill pool, you will play a key role in building the future automation capabilities of our Competence Center. You will develop robust control solutions, intuitive user interfaces and scalable automation architectures for products, machines and integrated systems.

Combining hands-on engineering with product development, requirements engineering and technology evaluation, you will work closely with internal teams and external partners to transform engineering solutions into modular, standardized and reusable platforms deployable across regions and throughout the product lifecycle.

You will also contribute to a modern engineering environment based on model-based development and automated PLC code generation, creating the foundations for AI-supported engineering methods.

**Your tasks**

- Developing and maintaining PLC-based control systems for machines, intelligent handling systems and process automation applications
- Designing intuitive HMI and UX solutions to ensure safe and efficient operation
- Defining functional concepts, interfaces and reusable software modules for modular product platforms
- Translating business and customer requirements into technical specifications and automation solutions
- Evaluating, testing and qualifying technologies, software components and automation solutions from external providers and providing fact-based recommendations for integration or make-or-buy decisions
- Supporting testing, commissioning, documentation and continuous improvement throughout the product lifecycle

**Your profile**

results.title: Automation and Validation Engineer
results.description:

Our R&D domains span Neural Network Processors (NPU), Vision DSPs, and advanced AI algorithms for applications across smartphones, tablets, automotive, surveillance cameras and many more edge AI systems.

We combine cutting-edge hardware IP design with embedded software and system-level solutions, enabling the next generation of intelligent and energy-efficient devices.

**About the Role:**

In this role, you will learn and deeply understand the AI fundamentals and create automatic AI based validation environment for **Ceva’s** AI neural network *processor* . In addition, you will perform in-depth analysis of failure root cause analysis*, to* ensure that functionality, performance and accuracy of **Ceva** ‘s AI and vision processors architectures are met.

The Validation is done using C/C++ and Python as main development languages for AI neural network automation and implementation. Validation and Automation is performed cross platform using Linux and Windows solutions.

**Responsibilities:**

Taking part of innovative, agile, top-notch Software Organization, designing Neural Network Processor (NPU) in close collaboration with the architecture, algorithms, front end and backend software, system and hardware teams.

Develop automated validation frameworks, tests and coverage for NPU software artifacts, simulator for neural network processing and embedded software, while using top notch validation methods and procedures.

- Good communication and organization skills, with a logical approach to problem solving.

results.title: Automation Engineer
results.description:
At Husqvarna Group, we develop innovative solutions that shape the future of sustainable productivity. As part of our automation and product development environment in Huskvarna, you will join a team working closely with advanced test systems, industrial automation, and product verification. Our engineers collaborate across multiple product groups and projects, contributing to the development, commissioning, and continuous improvement of automated systems that support world-class products and technologies. This is an opportunity to work in a technically advanced environment where innovation, teamwork, and continuous learning are central to our success.

**About the role**

We are looking for an experienced Automation Engineer to strengthen our team in Huskvarna. In this role, you will be responsible for developing, maintaining, and optimizing automation solutions and test systems used within our engineering and product development environment.

Your responsibilities will include:

- Programming and developing PLC-based automation solutions, primarily in Beckhoff TwinCAT 3
- Commissioning, troubleshooting, and optimizing automated equipment and test systems
- Supporting machine safety implementation and ensuring compliance with relevant standards
- Working with system integration and communication between automation systems and connected equipment
- Collaborating with internal stakeholders across product groups, projects, and improvement initiatives
- Participating in the development of new test solutions as well as the continuous improvement of existing systems
- Providing technical expertise and contributing to long-term automation strategies

This is a hands-on role where you will drive automation initiatives independently while working closely with engineers, developers, and internal customers.

**About you**

**Desired skills, qualifications, and experience**

- Degree in Automation Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related technical field
- Several years of experience working with industrial automation systems
- Extensive experience programming PLC systems in Beckhoff TwinCAT 3
- Experience with commissioning, troubleshooting, and optimization of automated systems
- Knowledge of machine safety standards and implementation
- Understanding of industrial communication protocols and system integration
- Experience working with test systems or automated production equipment is highly beneficial
- Fluent in English, both written and spoken
- Swedish language skills are strongly meritorious

**Personal attributes**

To succeed in this role, you are:

- Self-driven and comfortable taking ownership of technical solutions
- Analytical and structured in your approach to problem-solving
- Collaborative and able to build strong relationships across teams
- Curious and motivated by learning new technologies and concepts
- Quality-focused with a continuous improvement mindset
- Comfortable balancing independent work with teamwork in a dynamic environment

**What we offer**

At Husqvarna Group, you will have the opportunity to work with advanced technology in a global organization that values innovation, collaboration, and professional growth.

We offer:

- A technically challenging role with significant responsibility and influence
- Opportunities to work on advanced automation and test system solutions
- A collaborative and supportive work environment
- Professional development and continuous learning opportunities
- The possibility to contribute to products and technologies used worldwide
- A culture where innovation, teamwork, and individual growth are encouraged

**Location**

Huskvarna, Sweden.

**Your application**

Can you envision yourself being a part of this? If so, send us your application! Selection is ongoing. Note: We do not accept applications via email due to GDPR compliance.

For questions regarding the process please contact

Recruiter: Jonathan Olsson jonathan.olsson@husqvarnagroup.com or

Hiring Manager: Hans Berntsson, hans.berntsson@husqvarnagroup.com

**Winning Through Culture**

We believe that business is ultimately about people, as a team, we win and grow together. Our culture is built on bold ideas, strong commitment, and a shared purpose, creating an environment where innovation thrives, people grow, and every contribution matters.

Our culture is built on three core themes:

· Bold: We push boundaries, embrace challenges, and explore new possibilities.

· Dedicated: We put in the hard work, bring passion and resilience to every challenge we take on.

· Care: We support each other, consider the impact of our actions, and strive to make a lasting difference.

Whether you’re starting your career or looking for the next big step, we offer a place where passion and purpose come together. Join us in shaping the future!

results.title: Automation Squad - Senior Quality Engineer - Tieto Tech Consulting (m/f/d)
results.description:
Tieto Tech Consulting (MentorMate from 2001 to 2026) provides design-led, data-centric, and AI-powered digital engineering & consulting services to enterprises worldwide. With a strong heritage of Nordic quality, local presence, and global-scale operations, we are backed by 8,500+ IT professionals. Our clients trust us for advanced data and analytics skills, top industry-specific expertise, specialized software R&D, and the capabilities of a multinational team. We are part of Tieto, a leading technology company with an annual revenue of approximately EUR 2bn.

Tieto Tech Consulting’s team in Bulgaria consists of 500+ professionals specializing in the development of tailored digital solutions in diverse industries.

We are looking for a **Senior Quality Engineer** to join an Automation QA Squad. In this role, you will work closely with cross-functional teams while serving as a member of the Automation QA Squad, supporting delivery teams with automation expertise, automated test development, and the effective use of AI tools. The ideal candidate is strongly driven to expand automation capabilities and contribute to the successful achievement of automation objectives across projects.

This is an exciting opportunity for someone who enjoys owning quality end-to-end, from exploratory and functional testing to advanced automation practices while helping teams improve automation testing coverage and software quality.

**About the Position**

As an Automation Squad - Senior Quality Engineer, you will play a key role in strengthening quality engineering practices by combining:

- Manual and automation testing expertise
- Automation leadership and enablement

You will help establish scalable quality processes, improve automation coverage, support delivery teams with quality challenges, promote engineering best practices across multiple projects, and accelerate automation adoption across the organization.

This role is based on a hybrid work model, with 3 days per week in our Sofia office.

**Key Responsibilities**

- Drive test automation adoption and quality engineering improvements across teams
- Develop, optimize, and maintain automated test frameworks and test suites
- Transform manual test scenarios into maintainable automated solutions
- Integrate automated testing into CI/CD pipelines to enable faster and safer releases
- Create and execute testing strategies covering functional, integration, API, and end-to-end testing
- Evaluate and promote the effective use of AI-assisted tools and practices to improve testing efficiency, quality insights, and team productivity
- Identify opportunities to utilize AI-powered solutions for test design, test automation, defect analysis, and quality reporting
- Investigate defects, analyze root causes, and ensure effective issue tracking and reporting
- Collaborate with developers, product owners, and stakeholders to build quality into every stage of the development lifecycle
- Assess testing risks, identify gaps, and recommend improvements to products and processes
- Contribute to quality standards, engineering best practices, and continuous process optimization
- Facilitate knowledge-sharing sessions, workshops, and automation communities of practice
- Promote a culture of quality excellence and continuous learning

**Required Qualifications**

- Solid experience in software quality assurance and quality engineering
- Strong background in both manual testing and test automation
- Practical experience designing and implementing test automation frameworks
- Hands-on experience with modern automation tools such as Playwright, Selenium, Cypress, or similar
- Experience with JavaScript, TypeScript, or Java
- Experience testing both user interfaces and APIs
- Good understanding of modern software development practices and CI/CD pipelines
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
- Experience creating test strategies, test plans, quality metrics, and quality reports
- Passion for modern quality engineering practices, test automation, AI-assisted engineering tools, and continuous improvement
- Ability to work independently and take ownership of quality initiatives
- Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams
- Fluent written and spoken English
- Experience working within distributed and international teams

**Nice to Have**

- Experience coaching teams on test automation best practices
- Experience establishing automation frameworks and quality standards across multiple projects
- Experience facilitating knowledge-sharing sessions, workshops, or communities of practice
- Experience using AI-powered productivity, testing, or development tools
- Knowledge of AI-assisted test generation, defect analysis, or quality reporting solutions
- Experience with Jira, Xray, Confluence, BrowserStack, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, or similar platforms
- Mobile testing experience, including Appium or cross-device testing
- Experience leading quality initiatives within Agile teams
- Passion for continuous learning and technology innovation

**Why Join Us?**

- Join a highly skilled Automation QA Squad focused on quality engineering excellence
- Shape automation practices and quality standards across multiple projects and teams
- Support teams in advancing their testing and automation capabilities while driving the adoption of automation best practices
- Collaborate with highly skilled international teams
- Drive meaningful improvements in product quality and delivery efficiency
- Continuous learning and professional growth opportunities

At Tieto, we believe in the power of diversity, equity, and inclusion. We encourage applicants of all backgrounds, genders (m/f/d), and walks of life to join our team, as we believe that this fosters an inspiring workplace and fuels innovation. Our commitment to openness, trust, and diversity is at the heart of our mission to create digital futures that benefit businesses, societies, and humanity.
